messages:
alex: Heads up Acme's security team wants explicit CAIQ text on PrivateLink ownership, VPC flow logs, and who accepts egress risk. This is a hold on contracting. Need a pasteable answer.
mira: Copy of the ask: 'Please confirm who manages PrivateLink endpoints, VPC flow logs, and whether Redwood will forward logs to our SIEM or retain them.'
samir: Short answer here: Hosted customersRedwood manages the control plane and platform egress. For Dedicated/Private, customer owns their VPC resources (endpoints, routing, flow logs). We can forward logs from Redwood to customer sinks when configured.
eve: Draft CAIQ-safe paragraph: 

"Redwood operates a managed inference control plane. For hosted deployments, platform network egress and infrastructure audit logs are managed by Redwood and retained per contract. For Dedicated or Private (VPC-connected) deployments, customers provision and manage their VPC endpoints (including AWS PrivateLink), VPC flow logs, and local egress controls. Redwood can, via configuration and with appropriate IAM access, forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3, Kinesis, or SIEM) as an optional, SOW-defined integration."
mira: Can we add an explicit sentence about endpoint policy ownership for PrivateLink?
samir: Add: "When PrivateLink is used, the customer retains ownership of the VPC endpoint and associated endpoint policy; Redwood will not alter customer endpoint policies and terminates traffic at the configured interface on behalf of the customer"
josh-sales: Note for the SOW & POC: enabling log-forwarding for the POC is an engineering task (~2-4 engineer days) and may incur ingestion costs. I'll negotiate whether Acme covers it. Dont include pricing in CAIQ answers.
eve: Agreed  CAIQ responses should be posture focused. Put optional delivery details in SOW language: estimated effort and any third-party ingestion fees.
sec-bot: Template link: https://redwood.internal/sales/caicq-templates/network (requires perms) :white_check_mark:
alex: Need a one-paragraph version to paste into the SIG/CAIQ field. Keep it short and neutral.
mira: One-paragraph pasteable: "Redwood provides a managed inference control plane. For hosted deployments Redwood manages platform egress and retains platform audit logs per contract. For Dedicated/Private deployments customers provision and own VPC endpoints (including AWS PrivateLink), VPC flow logs, and local egress controls. Redwood can forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3/Kinesis/SIEM) when configured; forwarding is an optional SOW deliverable"
samir: Slight tweak to mention BYOK: "...and customer-managed KMS keys when BYOK is selected."
josh-sales: I'll push that into the CAIQ and follow up with Acme on the SOW for log-forwarding and timeline.
alex: If they ask for endpoint policy examples I'll ping samir. Thanks team. :rocket:
